visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Close-up of hands wearing purple latex gloves using a sharp chef's knife to slice into a thick, marbled piece of pink fish (bluefin tuna) on a wooden cutting board. The background shows a clean, bright food preparation area with white plates. (2) Medium shot of a young man with short dark hair holding a small green-rimmed plate with a single slice of tuna, shredded radish, and a dollop of wasabi. He has an exaggerated expression of shock and excitement. (3) The man uses chopsticks to put the large slice of tuna into his mouth. He is seated at a casual indoor dining table. He closes his eyes and gestures with his hands to show the intensity of the flavor. (4) Wide exterior shot of a modern, multi-story white building with a unique architectural design featuring multiple small circular windows and sharp angles. The text indicates it is the Pingtung King Boat Culture Museum. (5) Inside the museum, a massive, brightly colored traditional wooden 'King Boat' is displayed in a large atrium. The man stands next to it, providing a sense of scale. The boat is adorned with intricate paintings and figurines. (6) The man is seen talking to an older man with grey hair. They are standing in front of the ornate dragon paintings on the side of the boat. (7) An immersive theater room shows 360-degree projections of a large fire on the walls. The man stands in the center as a silhouette against the bright orange flames. (8) Shots of various museum exhibits including traditional dragon robes hanging from the ceiling and life-sized mannequins dressed in yellow traditional ritual outfits. (9) The man poses inside a replica of a colorful traditional Chinese gate. He looks slightly awkward and stiff for comedic effect. (10) Interior of a bright cafeteria-style dining area with light wood tables and a large 'Fish Port Dining' sign. (11) A modern bar area with red neon signs and large windows overlooking a city and bridge. (12) The man and the older man clink glasses of colorful, vibrant cocktails (blue, orange, green, purple) while sitting at a table with desserts.
